headline: New evening confusion since about mid-October, including a stove left on, has no documented work-up result. His caregiver grandson is exhausted and has asked for respite.

items.statement: On 2026-11-02 the RN noted that his grandson Robert reported about two weeks of increased evening confusion, with the stove left on once. Jerónimo was oriented to person and place but not date, and had no fever. The plan was urinalysis, medication review and a PCP visit that week. The chart has no urinalysis result, medication review or PCP visit after that date, and no encounters are recorded in the period.
items.verifier_note: The note matches the statement: about two weeks of evening confusion, the stove left on once, oriented to person and place but not date, no fever, and the plan. The encounters record is empty, which fits the absence claims. The note doesn't say Robert is the grandson, but that detail is minor.

items.statement: On 2026-11-22 the social worker met with Robert, his primary caregiver. Robert reported exhaustion and poor sleep, said he is worried about managing evenings alone, and requested respite. Respite options and a caregiver support group were discussed. No arrangement is documented yet.
items.verifier_note: The social work note matches each detail: Robert is the primary caregiver, he reports exhaustion and poor sleep, he is worried about evenings, he requests respite, and respite options and a support group were discussed. No arrangement is documented.

items.statement: The PT evaluation of 2026-09-29 (Timed Up and Go 19 seconds, slow and unsteady gait, walker, home safety evaluation and grab bar recommendations, twice-weekly PT) refers to a fall on 2026-09-25. A 2026-09-27 chart correction from Dr. Abernathy says the fall entry was documented on the wrong participant and should be disregarded. It is unclear whether the PT evaluation and its recommendations apply to Jerónimo.
items.verifier_note: The PT note has all the listed findings and the fall on 9/25. The 9/27 correction from Dr. Abernathy says the fall entry was for the wrong participant. The statement correctly says it is unclear whether the PT evaluation applies to him.

items.statement: No influenza vaccine is recorded for the current season, which started 2026-08-01. The most recent dose in the record is dated 2026-06-30.
